cluding COCO, ADE20K, and Pascal VOC, CLIP-Guided SAM consistently
outperforms SAM-based PEFT methods and VLM+SAM pipelines while re-
maining competitive with powerful promptable segmentation foundation models
such as SAM 3 under limited compute and supervision.

Overall, these results suggest that internal semantic co-adaptation provides a
practical alternative to shallow prompt-based coupling when adapting prompt-
able segmentation models under limited data and compute.
